app-intro: Upload a directory of photos to Wikimedia Commons.
files-unsupported: Opening directories needs the File System Access API, available in Chrome, Edge and other Chromium-based browsers.
files-hint: Open a directory with your photos. Subdirectories are included. Every picture is hashed (SHA-1) locally to find those already on Commons; nothing is uploaded yet.
describe-empty: Open a directory with pictures that are not on Commons yet.
describe-more-columns: Author, source and license per file
describe-keys: Enter: next row · Shift+Enter: previous row · paste cells from a spreadsheet into any cell
describe-fill-down: Fill empty cells with the value above
field-language-help: For descriptions without a language template, e.g. en → {{en|1=…}}
default-description-help: Used for files without a description
default-categories-help: Added to every file; separate with ;
default-author-help: Used for files without an author; empty: your user page
default-source-help: Used for files without a source
default-license-help: Used for files without a license
csv-import-help: Paste a table from a spreadsheet (tab-separated) or CSV (comma or semicolon). The first row names the columns; a “file” column matches rows to pictures by path or file name, else rows are taken in table order. Columns:
csv-copied: Copied $1 rows, paste them into a spreadsheet
problem-title-chars: The file name must not contain # < > [ ] | { } / : \ or ~~~.
problem-title-long: The file name is longer than 240 bytes.
problem-title-extension: The file name ends with a file extension; the original extension is added anyway.
problem-title-duplicate: Another selected file has the same name.
problem-title-exists: A file with this name already exists on Commons.
problem-title-camera: Names given by cameras (IMG_1234) are discouraged; use a descriptive name.
problem-author-missing: No author: log in, or set an author.
problem-location-invalid: Latitude and longitude must be numbers (−90…90, −180…180).
problem-file-large: Files larger than 100 MiB need a chunked upload, which is not supported yet.
upload-unavailable: Uploading needs a login, which is only available at
upload-login: Log in with your Wikimedia account to upload.
upload-test-notice: Test mode: files are uploaded to $1, not to Commons. Use it to try out a batch; files there may be deleted at any time.
pattern-help: Applied to the selected files in table order. Placeholders: number (zero-padded), current name, original file name, directory, day taken, description as text.
problem-categories-unknown: Categories that do not exist on Commons: $1.
problem-caption-long: The caption is longer than 250 characters and will not be saved.
problem-depicts-invalid: Depicts should only contain Wikidata item IDs (Q1234).
upload-sdc-failed: Uploaded, but captions and depicts were not saved: $1
